The project's own recipe in `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md` uses "rest at the inn" as its worked example. I built this list from that recipe plus the route, service and component docs. I didn't open the source files, so the line numbers come from the docs' anchors and may have drifted. ## Worker | File | Change | |---|---| | `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` next to the other `*Body` types, which sit around lines 139–168. Add a cost constant such as `INN_REST_COST`. The cost is a rule, so it belongs on the Worker. | | `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. The handler does the following:
• Validate the body.
• Call `getCharacter`.
• Return 400 if `gold < cost`.
• Return 400 if HP is already full, so the player isn't charged for nothing.
• Return 400 if the session's `combatState` is active. I couldn't confirm that the session stores `combatState` this way.
• Call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })`.
• Return `{ updatedCharacter, cost, narrative? }`.
• Optionally call `askDM` for narration, then `appendHistory`, `saveSession` and an `adventure_log` insert, following `routes/action.ts`. | | `worker/src/index.ts` (around lines 41–48) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. | | `worker/src/services/character.ts` | Probably no change. `updateCharacter` (around line 94) whitelists fields, so confirm that `hp` and `gold` are on the whitelist. | | `worker/migrations/` | No change. `characters` already has `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold`. | ## Frontend | File | Change | |---|---| | `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface, `{ updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number; narrative?: string }`. Put it near `ActionResponse` and `CombatResponse`. | | `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `rest()` handler next to `levelUp()` and `combatAction()`:
• Call `api.rest`.
• Call `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`.
• Push a system or narrative entry.
• Show `err.error.error` on failure.
• Update the campaign slot through `auth.updateCampaign` if you want it to match the other handlers. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (N gp)" button in the left column near the Inventory button. Disable it when `inCombat()`, when `gold < cost`, or when HP is full. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy:
• Success updates the character.
• The error path shows a message.
• The button is disabled in combat. | | `game-console.component.css` | Optional styling. | `CharacterStateService` needs no change. The new HTTP method is the only addition on the client side. ## Docs to update in the same change - `docs/code/worker/src/routes/rest.md` (new). - The doc beside every other changed file, with links on both ends. - `code.md`, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`. - `docs/PRD.md` §9, the API spec. - `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md` and possibly a new flow doc. - The routing table in `AGENTS.md`. ## Things to watch - The server must recheck gold and HP. The client checks are only for the UI. - The use-potion flow only changes HP locally and never saves it (B-05). Don't copy that pattern. Rest must save the change through `updateCharacter`. - After a death, HP stays at 0 and input stays enabled (B-10). Resting at the inn could become the recovery path. If so, decide whether resting from 0 HP is allowed.
